feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 June 2026 11:27am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 18 June 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the west of the area overnight, but often a force or two lighter in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at first, clearing to patchy drizzle this afternoon, but with areas of mist and fog patches spreading from the south. Further rain tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or mist, then very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, falling 3 to 5 in all waters tomorrow afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 again for a time overnight, then veering west or southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, becoming patchier in the evening, then mostly fair overnight. Mist and fog patches persisting until later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or mist. Very poor in fog patches.
